import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:word_app/controller/settings_controller.dart';
import 'package:word_app/env/env.dart';
import 'package:word_app/features/review_screen/widgets/quiz_dropdown.dart';
import 'package:word_app/features/setting_screen/widgets/setting_in_quiz_screen_section.dart';
import 'package:word_app/helpers/constants.dart';

import '../../../features/kanji_detail_modal/support/hanzi_modal_support.dart';
import '../../../test_helper.dart';

Future<void> _shoot(
  WidgetTester tester, {
  required String name,
  required List<QuizType> Function(List<QuizType> available) select,
  bool dark = false,
}) async {
  ENV.hasExample = true;
  SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({if (dark) 'isLightTheme': false});
  Get.delete<SettingsController>(force: true);
  Get.put(SettingsController());
  useTestViewSize(tester, const Size(414, 900));

  await tester.pumpWidget(
    const TestWidget(
      child: SingleChildScrollView(child: SettingInQuizScreenSection()),
    ),
  );
  await tester.runAsync(
    () => Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 100)),
  );
  SettingsController.to.selectedQuizTypes(
    select(QuizDropdown.availableQuizTypes),
  );
  await tester.pumpAndSettle();

  await expectLater(
    find.byType(TestWidget),
    matchesGoldenFile('goldens/setting_in_quiz_screen_section_$name.png'),
  );
}

void main() {
  group('문제 유형 항목 기준 이미지', () {
    testWidgets('요약이 유형 1개 이름이다', (tester) async {
      await _shoot(tester, name: 'quiz_type_single', select: (a) => [a.first]);
    }, tags: ['golden']);

    testWidgets('요약이 N개 선택이다', (tester) async {
      await _shoot(
        tester,
        name: 'quiz_type_count_dark',
        select: (a) => a.take(3).toList(),
        dark: true,
      );
    }, tags: ['golden']);

    testWidgets('요약이 전체이다', (tester) async {
      await _shoot(tester, name: 'quiz_type_all', select: (a) => a);
    }, tags: ['golden']);
  });
}
